_comment: Label definitions for this repository, applied by tools/sync-labels.php.
Spelled out in full on purpose: no abbreviations a stranger has to look up.
mode 'sync'        : created if missing, and its colour and description are brought back to this file's values.
mode 'create-only' : created if missing, NEVER edited if it already exists (used for labels whose live
definition predates this file and may have been tuned by hand).
Nothing in this file deletes or renames a label. Removing a label is a maintainer decision made by hand.
A description is at most 100 characters (GitHub's limit); a colour is six hex digits with no leading #.

labels.name: needs triage
labels.description: New and not yet read by a person. The triage bot adds it; the maintainer removes it.

labels.name: confirmed
labels.description: The maintainer reproduced this, or confirmed it from the code.

labels.name: live operations
labels.description: The reporter says this is affecting a real, current operation.

labels.name: planned
labels.description: Accepted and intended to be built. Not a promise of a date.

labels.name: on hold
labels.description: Deliberately paused. The thread says why and when it will be looked at again.

labels.name: fixed in main
labels.description: The fix is in main on this repository. Run git pull to get it.

labels.name: needs reporter
labels.description: Waiting for the reporter to answer a question or confirm a fix.

labels.name: windows/iis
labels.description: Reported on a Windows or IIS install.

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: A new feature or a request to change behaviour.

labels.name: question
labels.description: A question about installing, configuring or running TicketsCAD.
